# Samadhan

> Samadhan is an AI-powered civic issue reporting and resolution platform built for Indian citizens. It bridges the gap between citizens and their local government by providing a transparent, accountable, and data-driven channel for reporting, tracking, and resolving everyday civic problems.

## What is Samadhan?

Samadhan (Sanskrit: समाधान, meaning "resolution") allows any Indian citizen to submit a civic complaint — a broken streetlight, overflowing garbage, damaged road, or water shortage — and have it automatically classified, prioritized, and routed to the correct government department using AI.

## Key Features

- AI-powered report classification (category, severity, priority, department routing)
- Real-time citizen dashboard for tracking report status
- Location-aware routing by ward and state
- Civic gamification with impact scores and leaderboards
- Secure authentication with role-based access (Citizen / Official / Admin)
- Avatar-based user profiles with Supabase storage
- Fully responsive, production-deployed on Vercel

## Tech Stack

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Vanilla CSS, Framer Motion
- Backend / Auth / Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Storage)
- AI Engine: Google Gemini (via API)
- Deployment: Vercel

## Who built this?

Samadhan was built by Souradeep Pradhan, a 3rd-year Computer Science student, as a submission for the "Build What Moves India" hackathon.

https://samadhan-in.vercel.app/
